title: Machine-learning decoders for fusion-based quantum computing in real time
abstract: arXiv:2611.13630v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires decoders that combine accuracy, throughput, low latency, and scalability to large numbers of physical qubits. In photonic fusion-based architectures, erasures from photon loss and probabilistic fusion measurements are a dominant error mechanism, motivating decoders that remain accurate at high erasure rates. We introduce PRISM, a transformer-based machine-learning decoder designed to exploit the known locations of erasures in protocols subject to both Pauli and erasure errors. We benchmark PRISM across a wide range of fault-tolerant protocols based on surface codes, color codes, and quantum low-density parity-check codes, with distances up to 24. Across these benchmarks, PRISM matches the logical error rates of integer-programming-based decoders while being significantly faster, including at error rates up to 50% of threshold. translated_title: 面向融合型量子计算的实时机器学习译码器
translated_abstract: 容错量子计算需要兼具高准确性、高吞吐量、低延迟并可扩展至大量物理量子比特的译码器。在基于融合的光子架构中，光子损失和概率性融合测量所导致的擦除是主导性的错误机制，因此需要能够在高擦除率下仍保持准确性的译码器。我们提出了PRISM，这是一种基于Transformer的机器学习译码器，专为利用协议中擦除位置的已知信息而设计，可同时处理Pauli错误和擦除错误。我们在基于表面码、颜色码和量子低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）码的广泛容错协议上对PRISM进行了基准测试，码距最高达到24。在所有这些基准测试中，PRISM在逻辑错误率上与基于整数规划的译码器相当，同时速度显著更快，包括在错误率高达阈值50%的情况下依然表现出色。我们进一步优化了该译码器及其实时硬件实现。
tldr: 提出了PRISM——一种基于Transformer的机器学习译码器，可在高擦除率下为融合型光子量子计算提供实时高精度译码，其逻辑错误率与整数规划译码器相当而速度显著更快。
en_tdlr: PRISM, a transformer-based machine-learning decoder, enables real-time high-accuracy decoding for fusion-based photonic quantum computing at high erasure rates, matching the logical error rates of integer-programming decoders while being significantly faster.
